			function rgbToHsv(p770)
				local v2739 = p770.R
				local v2740 = p770.G
				local v2741 = p770.B
				local v2742 = math.max(v2739, v2740, v2741)
				local v2743 = v2742 - math.min(v2739, v2740, v2741)
				local v2744 = 0
				local v2745
				if 0 < v2743 then
					if v2742 == v2739 then
						pcall(function() v2745 = (v2740 - v2741) / v2743 % 6 end)
					elseif v2742 == v2740 then
						pcall(function() v2745 = (v2741 - v2739) / v2743 + 2 end)
					else
						pcall(function() v2745 = (v2739 - v2740) / v2743 + _K[41] end)
					end
					pcall(function() v2744 = v2745 / _K[6] end)
					if v2744 < 0 then
						pcall(function() v2744 = v2744 + _K[3] end)
					end
				end
				local v2746
				v2746 = 0 < v2742 and v2743 / v2742 or 0
				return v2744, v2746, v2742
			end

    local reg = _G._FH_REG_PodiumESP
    if not reg then return end
    local Plots = workspace:WaitForChild("Plots", 15)
    if not Plots then return end
    local COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(55, 185, 255)
    local FLOOR_TOL, DEDUP_R = 8, 10
    local holder, conns = nil, {}
    local function baseBounds(slot)
      local target = slot:FindFirstChild("Base") or slot
      if target:IsA("Model") then local ok, cf, sz = pcall(function() return target:GetBoundingBox() end) if ok then return cf, sz end
      elseif target:IsA("BasePart") then return target.CFrame, target.Size end
    end
    local function makeBox(cf, size)
      local a = Instance.new("Part") a.Anchored=true a.CanCollide=false a.CanQuery=false a.CanTouch=false a.Transparency=1 a.Size=size a.CFrame=cf a.Parent=holder
      local b = Instance.new("SelectionBox") b.Adornee=a b.Color3=COLOR b.SurfaceColor3=COLOR b.LineThickness=0.06 b.Transparency=0 b.SurfaceTransparency=0.82 b.Parent=a
    end
    local function floorOffsets()
      local best
      for _, plot in ipairs(Plots:GetChildren()) do
        local pods = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
        if pods then
          local ys = {}
          for _, sl in ipairs(pods:GetChildren()) do local cf = baseBounds(sl) if cf then ys[#ys+1] = cf.Position.Y end end
          table.sort(ys)
          local lv = {}
          for _, y in ipairs(ys) do local f=false for _,l in ipairs(lv) do if math.abs(l-y)<=FLOOR_TOL then f=true break end end if not f then lv[#lv+1]=y end end
          if not best or #lv > #best then best = lv end
        end
      end
      local offs = {}
      if best and #best >= 2 then for i=2,#best do offs[#offs+1] = best[i]-best[1] end end
      return offs
    end
    local function build()
      if not holder then return end
      for _, c in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do c:Destroy() end
      local offs = floorOffsets()
      for _, plot in ipairs(Plots:GetChildren()) do
        local pods = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
        if pods then
          local slots, live, minY = {}, {}, math.huge
          for _, sl in ipairs(pods:GetChildren()) do
            local cf, sz = baseBounds(sl)
            if cf then slots[#slots+1]={cf=cf,sz=sz} live[#live+1]=cf.Position minY=math.min(minY,cf.Position.Y) end
          end
          for _, s in ipairs(slots) do makeBox(s.cf, s.sz) end
          for _, s in ipairs(slots) do
            if s.cf.Position.Y <= minY + FLOOR_TOL then
              for _, dy in ipairs(offs) do
                local up = s.cf + Vector3.new(0, dy, 0)
                local exists=false for _,lp in ipairs(live) do if (lp-up.Position).Magnitude<=DEDUP_R then exists=true break end end
                if not exists then makeBox(up, s.sz) end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    local pend=false
    local function rebuild() if pend then return end pend=true task.delay(0.4,function() pend=false if holder then pcall(build) end end) end
    local function enable()
      if holder then return end
      local old = workspace:FindFirstChild("__FH_PodiumMarkers") if old then old:Destroy() end
      holder = Instance.new("Folder") holder.Name="__FH_PodiumMarkers" holder.Parent=workspace
      pcall(build)
      for _, plot in ipairs(Plots:GetChildren()) do task.spawn(function() local pods=plot:WaitForChild("AnimalPodiums",20) if pods then conns[#conns+1]=pods.ChildAdded:Connect(rebuild) conns[#conns+1]=pods.ChildRemoved:Connect(rebuild) end end) end
      conns[#conns+1]=Plots.ChildAdded:Connect(function() rebuild() end)
    end
    local function disable()
      for _,c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end conns={}
      if holder then holder:Destroy() holder=nil end
    end
    local last = nil
    game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
      local s = reg.enabled and true or false
      if s ~= last then last=s if s then pcall(enable) else pcall(disable) end end
    end)
  end)

      if tick() < wu then
        if fill then fill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0); fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 200, 90) end
        if pctLbl then pctLbl.Text = "100%" end
        if nameLbl then nameLbl.Text = "Stealing Now!" end
        if statusLbl then statusLbl.Text = string.format("%.1fs", math.max(0, wu - tick())) end
      elseif AG.hasTarget and AG.targetName then
        if fill then fill.Size = UDim2.new(prog, 0, 1, 0); fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 60, 60) end
        if pctLbl then pctLbl.Text = string.format("%d%%", math.floor(prog * 100 + 0.5)) end
        if nameLbl then nameLbl.Text = tostring(AG.targetName) end
        if statusLbl then statusLbl.Text = "" end
      else
        if fill then fill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0); fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 60, 60) end
        if pctLbl then pctLbl.Text = "0%" end
        if nameLbl then nameLbl.Text = "" end
        if statusLbl then statusLbl.Text = "searching..." end
      end
    end)
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if header and root and not gg:GetAttribute("__fhDrag") then
      gg:SetAttribute("__fhDrag", true)
      pcall(function() for _,c in ipairs(getconnections(header.InputBegan)) do c:Disconnect() end end)
      header.Active = true; root.Active = true
      local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
      local dragging, ds, sp
      header.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
          dragging = true; ds = i.Position; sp = root.Position
          i.Changed:Connect(function() if i.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end end)
        end
      end)
      UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if dragging and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
          local dl = i.Position - ds
          root.Position = UDim2.new(sp.X.Scale, sp.X.Offset + dl.X, sp.Y.Scale, sp.Y.Offset + dl.Y)
        end
      end)
    end
  end)
end)
task.spawn(function()
  local myGen = _G._FH_GAMMA_GEN
  task.wait(1.5)
  if _G._FH_GAMMA_GEN ~= myGen then return end
  pcall(function()
    local char = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    for _, c in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
      if c:IsA("LinearVelocity") and c.VelocityConstraintMode == Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Plane then
        local a0 = c.Attachment0
        if a0 and a0.Parent and a0.Parent.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
          local att = c.Parent
          pcall(function() c:Destroy() end)
          if att and att:IsA("Attachment") and #att:GetChildren() == 0 then pcall(function() att:Destroy() end) end
        end
      end
    end
  end)
end)
task.spawn(function()
  local myGen = _G._FH_GAMMA_GEN
  local Players = game:GetService("Players")
  local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
  local Wk = workspace
  local V3 = Vector3.new
  local semiSlots = {
    [1] = { podiums = {"1","10"}, pairs = { {p=V3(-337,-5,103), g=V3(-348,-7,82)}, {p=V3(-337,-5,18), g=V3(-349.43,-6.78,37.47)} } },
    [2] = { podiums = {"2","9"}, pairs = { {p=V3(-330,-5,102), g=V3(-349,-7,86)}, {p=V3(-329,-5,18), g=V3(-347,-7,32)} } },
    [3] = { podiums = {"3","8"}, pairs = { {p=V3(-323,-5,102), g=V3(-345,-7,92)}, {p=V3(-323,-4,18), g=V3(-344,-7,29)} } },
    [4] = { podiums = {"4","7"}, pairs = { {p=V3(-316,-5,102), g=V3(-337.6,-6.4,91.6)}, {p=V3(-315,-5,18), g=V3(-336.7,-6.4,28.2)} } },
    [5] = { podiums = {"5","6"}, pairs = { {p=V3(-308,-5,102), g=V3(-331.3,-6.2,93.2)}, {p=V3(-308,-5,18), g=V3(-330.4,-6.1,26.6)} } },
    [6] = { podiums = {"6"}, pairs = { {p=V3(-307,-5,125), g=V3(-321.8,-5.7,113.1)}, {p=V3(-308,-5,55), g=V3(-330.4,-6.1,63.6)} } },
    [7] = { podiums = {"7"}, pairs = { {p=V3(-315,-5,125), g=V3(-328.4,-5.8,111.6)}, {p=V3(-315,-5,55), g=V3(-336.7,-6.4,65.2)} } },
    [8] = { podiums = {"8"}, pairs = { {p=V3(-322,-5,125), g=V3(-333.8,-5.9,110.1)}, {p=V3(-323,-4,55), g=V3(-344,-7,66)} } },
    [9] = { podiums = {"9"}, pairs = { {p=V3(-330,-5,125), g=V3(-339.3,-6,108.4)}, {p=V3(-329,-5,55), g=V3(-347,-7,69)} } },
    [10] = { podiums = {"10"}, pairs = { {p=V3(-337,-5,125), g=V3(-343.3,-6.1,107.1)}, {p=V3(-337,-5,55), g=V3(-349.43,-6.78,74.47)} } },
  }
  local flyNames = {"Flying Carpet","Cupid's Wings","Witch's Broom","Waverider","Santa's Sleigh"}
  local function getSS()
    local ok, v = pcall(function() return SS end)
    if ok and type(v) == "table" and v.selectedSlot ~= nil then return v end
    ok, v = pcall(function() return HalfwaySteal end)
    if ok and type(v) == "table" and v.selectedSlot ~= nil then return v end
    if getgenv then local g = getgenv() if type(g.SS) == "table" then return g.SS end end
    return nil
  end
  local function getHRP()
    local c = LP.Character
    return c and (c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or c:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"))
  end
  local function plotOwner(plot)
    local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
    local frame = sign and sign:FindFirstChild("SurfaceGui") and sign.SurfaceGui:FindFirstChild("Frame")
    local label = frame and frame:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")
    if not label or label.Text == "Empty Base" then return nil end
    return (label.Text:gsub("'s [Bb]ase$", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""))
  end
  local function getEnemyPlots()
    local res, myName = {}, LP.DisplayName
    local pf = Wk:FindFirstChild("Plots")
    if not pf then return res end
    for _, plot in ipairs(pf:GetChildren()) do
      local owner = plotOwner(plot)
      if owner and owner ~= myName then res[#res + 1] = plot end
    end
    return res
  end
  local function getPodiumPrompt(podium)
    local base = podium:FindFirstChild("Base")
    local sp = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
    local att = sp and sp:FindFirstChild("PromptAttachment")
    local prompt = att and att:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt")
    return (prompt and prompt.ActionText == "Steal") and prompt or nil
  end
  local function getClosestPodium(nums)
    local hrp = getHRP()
    if not hrp then return nil end
    local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
    for _, plot in ipairs(getEnemyPlots()) do
      local podiums = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
      if podiums then
        for _, num in ipairs(nums) do
          local podium = podiums:FindFirstChild(num)
          local claimF = podium and podium:FindFirstChild("Claim")
          local claim = claimF and claimF:FindFirstChild("Main")
          local prompt = podium and getPodiumPrompt(podium)
          if claim and prompt then
            local d = (hrp.Position - claim.Position).Magnitude
            if d < bestDist then
              bestDist = d
              local att = prompt.Parent
              local podiumPos = att and (att:IsA("Attachment") and att.WorldPosition or att.Position) or claim.Position
              best = { promptPos = podiumPos, claimPos = claim.Position, prompt = prompt }
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return best
  end
  local function buildStealCb(prompt)
    if not getconnections then return nil end
    local data = { hold = {}, trigger = {} }
    local ok1, c1 = pcall(getconnections, prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan)
    if ok1 and type(c1) == "table" then for _, c in ipairs(c1) do if type(c.Function) == "function" then data.hold[#data.hold + 1] = c.Function end end end
    local ok2, c2 = pcall(getconnections, prompt.Triggered)
    if ok2 and type(c2) == "table" then for _, c in ipairs(c2) do if type(c.Function) == "function" then data.trigger[#data.trigger + 1] = c.Function end end end
    if #data.hold == 0 and #data.trigger == 0 then return nil end
    return data
  end
  local function equipFly()
    local char = LP.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end
    for _, n in ipairs(flyNames) do if char:FindFirstChild(n) then return end end
    local bp = LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
    for _, n in ipairs(flyNames) do
      local it = bp and bp:FindFirstChild(n)
      if it then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(it) end) return end
    end
  end
  local function disableAutoGrab()
    pcall(function()
      local ok, ag = pcall(function() return AutoGrab end)
      if ok and type(ag) == "table" then
        if ag.setNearest then pcall(ag.setNearest, false) end
        if ag.setBest then pcall(ag.setBest, false) end
        if ag.setPriorityGrab then pcall(ag.setPriorityGrab, false) end
        if ag.setFast then pcall(ag.setFast, false) end
        if ag.setFastGrab then pcall(ag.setFastGrab, false) end
      end
    end)
  end
  local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
  local busy = false
  local function semiSteal()
    if busy then return end
    busy = true
    local okRun = pcall(function()
      local char = LP.Character
      local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if not hrp then return end
      local SSo = getSS()
      local slot = tonumber(SSo and SSo.selectedSlot) or 1
      if slot < 1 or slot > 10 then slot = 1 end
      local cfg = semiSlots[slot] or semiSlots[1]
      local target = getClosestPodium(cfg.podiums)
      if not (target and target.prompt and target.prompt.Parent) then return end
      local cb = buildStealCb(target.prompt)
      if not cb then return end
      local pp = target.promptPos
      local groundY = target.claimPos.Y + 3.5
      local dir = Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X - pp.X, 0, hrp.Position.Z - pp.Z)
      if dir.Magnitude < 1 then dir = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) end
      dir = dir.Unit
      local maxD = target.prompt.MaxActivationDistance
      if type(maxD) ~= "number" or maxD <= 0 then maxD = 10 end
      local standPos = Vector3.new(pp.X, groundY, pp.Z) + dir * math.min(3, math.max(1, maxD - 5))
      local grabPos = Vector3.new(pp.X, groundY, pp.Z) + dir * math.min(5, math.max(2, maxD - 3))
      disableAutoGrab()
      equipFly()
      task.wait(0.1)
      local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
      att.Parent = hrp
      local lv = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
      lv.Attachment0 = att
      lv.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
      lv.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Vector
      pcall(function() lv.ForceLimitMode = Enum.ForceLimitMode.PerAxis end)
      pcall(function() lv.MaxAxesForce = Vector3.new(1000000, 0, 1000000) end)
      lv.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero
      lv.Parent = hrp
      if hum then pcall(function() hum.Sit = true end) end
      local function moveTo(tgt, thresh, timeout)
        local t0 = tick()
        while hrp and hrp.Parent do
          local d = tgt - hrp.Position
          local flat = Vector3.new(d.X, 0, d.Z)
          if flat.Magnitude < (thresh or 3) then break end
          if tick() - t0 > (timeout or 6) then break end
          local u = flat.Unit
          lv.VectorVelocity = Vector3.new(u.X * 130, 0, u.Z * 130)
          RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
        lv.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero
      end
      local FRONT_WP = Vector3.new(-353, -7, 6)
      local BACK_WP = Vector3.new(-354, -7, 92)
      local waypoints
      if standPos.Z >= 60 then waypoints = { FRONT_WP, BACK_WP } else waypoints = { BACK_WP, FRONT_WP } end
      local startIdx, bd = 1, math.huge
      for i = 1, #waypoints do local dd = (hrp.Position - waypoints[i]).Magnitude if dd < bd then bd = dd startIdx = i end end
      for i = startIdx, #waypoints do moveTo(waypoints[i], 4, 6) end
      moveTo(standPos, 2, 4)
      for _, fn in ipairs(cb.hold) do task.spawn(fn) end
      local hd = target.prompt.HoldDuration
      if type(hd) ~= "number" or hd < 0.3 then hd = 1.3 end
      task.wait(hd + 0.05)
      moveTo(grabPos, 2, 3)
      task.wait(0.03)
      for _, fn in ipairs(cb.trigger) do task.spawn(fn) end
      pcall(function() lv.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero end)
      pcall(function() lv:Destroy() end)
      pcall(function() att:Destroy() end)
      if hum then pcall(function() hum.Sit = false end) end
      local st = tick()
      while LP:GetAttribute("Stealing") == nil do if tick() - st >= 1 then break end task.wait(0.05) end
    end)
    busy = false
    return okRun
  end
  local SSo
  for _ = 1, 300 do
    if _G._FH_GAMMA_GEN ~= myGen then return end
    SSo = getSS()
    if SSo then break end
    task.wait(0.1)
  end
  if not SSo then return end
  while _G._FH_GAMMA_GEN == myGen do
    local cur = getSS()
    if cur and cur.SSDoTeleport ~= semiSteal then
      pcall(function() cur.SSDoTeleport = semiSteal end)
      pcall(function() cur.SSDoSteal = semiSteal end)
    end
    task.wait(1)
  end
end)
_G.__FB_END=os.clock()
